title: Defer JDBC session settings while preserving physical connection state
summary: Individual client-info and timeout settings now wait for first physical use. One consuming read applied the latest value, preserved the driver's unrelated key, and left the unused handle unmaterialized.

change.description: LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy defers per-name client info and network timeouts until first physical use. Bulk client info and reads of client info still require the driver.

notes: Each physical connection owns separate settings. The control observed an immediate checkout for both a driver-supplied value and a bulk Properties write.
